text:
It's summer. Everyone's brown. You're pale.

Pale skin broadcasts one message: you hide indoors, you don't move.

Sun daily. Vitamin D, magnesium, zinc. Sleep 7 hours. Drink water.

A tan makes your muscles sharp. Makes you look alive. Makes you look like you actually do things.

Pale men stay invisible. Tanned men get seen.
caption:
Your pale skin kills your self improvement and discipline before anyone gives you a chance.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#SelfImprovement #Discipline #Mindset #SuccessHabits #Men
